tool.name: MeanFilter
tool.summary: Mean filter: the mean of the values around each cell (a moving average), which smooths the grid. No-data cells are left out of each mean.

param.name: in_raster
param.dialogReference: Grid to process (a single-band raster; no-data cells are left as no-data in the result).
param.pythonReference: Grid to process (a single-band raster; no-data cells are left as no-data in the result).

param.name: out_raster
param.dialogReference: Output raster (GeoTIFF), with the input's extent, cell size and coordinate system.
param.pythonReference: Output raster (GeoTIFF), with the input's extent, cell size and coordinate system.

param.name: kernel_size
param.dialogReference: Width of the square window in pixels (odd).
param.pythonReference: Width of the square window in pixels (odd).
